name: Chengdu Fine Optical Engineering Research Center
zh: 成都精密光学工程研究中心
supervisors: China Academy of Engineering Physics (per the Canadian and US lists)

evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list names the Chengdu Fine Optical Engineering Research Center among the known aliases of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP), and the US Commerce Department listed it in 2020 as one of ten entities owned by, operated by or directly affiliated with CAEP, the complex responsible for researching, developing and testing China’s nuclear weapons.
